description.en: The CoreSense Ontology in OWL 2, generated from the SysML v2 model in sysml/coresense/, which is the canonical source. Each term records the SysML definition it derives from.

definition.value: A function is a transformation that maps specific inputs to outputs.
A system is an entity represented by a tuple (C, R), where C is a set of components and R is the set of binary relations between them.
Minted by the generator for the SysML v2 standard-library element referenced as Action.
A WorldModel is a Model whose referent is the ExtendedSystem being operated in.

comment.en: SysML constraint UsedByInTargetOrEnvironment: referent.targetSystem.components->SequenceFunctions::includes(usedBy) or referent.environmentEntities->SequenceFunctions::includes(usedBy)

definition.value: Performance constraint on model usage (e.g., for run-time use).

comment.en: SysML constraint ResponseTime: actualResponseTime <= maxResponseTime

definition.value: An entity is any thing in the universe of discourse that can be distinguished from all other things in that universe.

Given an extended system, the context is the set of the content retained about that extended system, together with the assumptions and conditions, deemed relevant to interpret, evaluate and act within that extended system.
Pairing of a modelet with an engine that can exert it.

comment.en: SysML constraint EngineSupportsModelet: engine.modelets->SequenceFunctions::includes(modelet)

definition.value: An action order is an executable directive, issued within a given context of an extended system, that activates the execution of the actions in a given action specification by the designated agents.
Estimation is a cognitive function realized by a modelet-engine pair whose purpose is to infer unknown or uncertain quantities of a referent from available data and prior knowledge.

A feature is a derived piece of information that encodes some characteristic of an entity, system, phenomenon, or context, obtained from observations or sensor data and used as input to functions or modelets.
Understanding is the capability of an entity to construct and use models of a phenomenon or system in order to make reliable inferences about it.
Data are encoded representations of aspects of an entity or system (e.g., phenomena, properties, states, or attributes) in a form suitable for communication, storage, or processing.

An action trigger is a condition on the state and/or exhibited behavior of an extended system, identified within a given context, whose satisfaction indicates the need to initiate the execution of one or more actions to contribute to the achievement or maintenance of one or more goals.
A trajectory is a time-ordered sequence of states representing one possible evolution of the system over a time interval.

comment.en: SysML constraint StrictlyIncreasingTime: SequenceFunctions::size(states) == 1 or (1..(SequenceFunctions::size(states) - 1))->ControlFunctions::forAll { in i : Natural; states#(i).timeInstant < states#(i + 1).timeInstant }

definition.value: The potential behavior of a system over a time interval is the set of all trajectories the system may follow over that interval.

comment.en: SysML constraint TrajectoriesAtSameInterval: trajectories->ControlFunctions::forAll { in tr : SystemTrajectory; tr.timeInterval.initialTime == timeInterval.initialTime and tr.timeInterval.finalTime == timeInterval.finalTime }

definition.value: Exertion is the process of executing one or more modelets to given inputs in order to derive results about their referent.
A mission success criterion pairs a metric with a satisfaction condition in a given context.
A task is a set of planned actions, executed by one or more agents, that is intended to contribute to the achievement of one or more goals within a given context.

comment.en: SysML constraint GoalsOfSameExtendedSystem: goals->ControlFunctions::forAll { in g : Goal; g.extendedSystem == extendedSystem }

definition.value: The state of a system at a time instant is the complete set of attribute values describing the current condition of its components and their relations.

comment.en: SysML constraint ComponentBelongToSystem: componentStates->ControlFunctions::forAll { in es : EntityState; entity.components->SequenceFunctions::includes(es.entity) }

definition.value: The exhibited behavior of a system over an observational interval is the trajectory followed by the system during that interval.
A SelfModel is a Model whose referent is the owning system itself.

comment.en: SysML constraint SelfEquality: referent == usedBy

definition.value: A functionality is an instantiation of a capability with some expected performance that is intended to satisfy one or more goals within a given context.

comment.en: SysML constraint ObjectWithinExtendedSystem: object == context.extendedSystem or context.extendedSystem.targetSystem.components->SequenceFunctions::includes(object)

definition.value: An actuator is a physical entity that, when provided with an input, produces a physical effect on the environment or the system (e.g., motion, force, or flow), thereby executing actions commanded by an agent.
An engine is a component that exerts a modelet to derive a result.

comment.en: SysML constraint ExertionUseTheseModelets: exerts->ControlFunctions::forAll { in x : Exert; x.modelets->ControlFunctions::forAll { in m : Modelet; modelets->SequenceFunctions::includes(m) } }

definition.value: An extended system is composed of a target system together with its selected environment and the relations between both of them.

comment.en: SysML constraint EnvironmentEntitySetMatches: environment.entities->ControlFunctions::forAll { in e : Entity; environmentEntities->SequenceFunctions::includes(e) } and environmentEntities->ControlFunctions::forAll { in e : Entity; environment.entities->SequenceFunctions::includes(e) }

definition.value: An action end is an event that, within a given context, marks the termination of the execution of an action, together with a termination status value.

comment.en: SysML constraint IsEndShotOfAction: self == terminatedAction.endShot

definition.value: A stakeholder is an entity for whom a system S is relevant because the behavior or outcomes of S can affect the achievement of its own goals.

comment.en: SysML constraint OwnsDesires: desires->ControlFunctions::forAll { in d : Desire; d.who == self }

definition.value: An event is an occurrence that represents a change in an extended system.

comment.en: SysML constraint Instantaneous: startShot == endShot

definition.value: Performance is a measure of how effectively the exhibited behavior of a system (or one of its components) contributes to fulfilling its goals when executing tasks within a given context.

comment.en: SysML constraint BehaviorOfTargetSystem: exhibitedBehavior.system == context.extendedSystem.targetSystem
SysML constraint SameSystem: capability.system == task.extendedSystem.targetSystem

definition.value: A policy is a rule or strategy that, for a given action trigger and a given context of an extended system, determines a set of candidate actions that are admissible responses to that trigger in that context.
A concern is a matter of interest to a stakeholder that, in a given context, can be derived from a need and may give rise to requirements.
A mission is a high-level goal expressed as desired effects or target conditions for an extended system within a given context.
Awareness is the capability of an entity to maintain timely understanding of a phenomenon and its implications for the entity.

comment.en: SysML constraint UnderstandingOfSamePhenomenon: maintainedUnderstanding.understoodPhenomenon == awarePhenomenon

definition.value: The environment of a system is the collection of entities that are not part of the system but are capable of influencing or being influenced by it.

comment.en: SysML constraint DisjointWithSystem: entities->ControlFunctions::forAll { in e : Entity; e != system and not system.components->SequenceFunctions::includes(e) }

definition.value: A phenomenon is any distinguishable aspect or behavior of an extended system, or of one of its parts, within a given context.

comment.en: SysML constraint ExhibitedByWithinExtendedSystem: exhibitedBy->ControlFunctions::forAll { in b : Entity; b == extendedSystem or b == extendedSystem.targetSystem or extendedSystem.targetSystem.components->SequenceFunctions::includes(b) or extendedSystem.environmentEntities->SequenceFunctions::includes(b) }

definition.value: Scalability constraint on model usage (e.g., number of concurrent users).

comment.en: SysML constraint Scalability: numberOfUsers <= maxUsers

definition.value: A situation is a context-dependent condition on the state or exhibited behavior of an extended system, expressed in terms of a finite subset of relevant attribute values and relation instances.
Acquire raw sensor data about the phenomenon being observed in the extended system.

comment.en: SysML constraint TargetWithinExtendedSystem: target == extendedSystem.targetSystem or extendedSystem.targetSystem.components->SequenceFunctions::includes(target) or extendedSystem.environmentEntities->SequenceFunctions::includes(target)

definition.value: A risk is a measure of the potential for an adverse event to negatively affect an entity, system, or extended system within a given context.

comment.en: SysML constraint LikelihoodBounds: 0.0 <= likelihood and likelihood <= 1.0

definition.value: A mission specification is the set of specific goals refining a given mission, together with the mission success criteria (expressed as metrics and their satisfaction conditions) that enable assessment of mission success.

comment.en: SysML constraint GoalsConsistentWithMission: goals->ControlFunctions::forAll { in g : Goal; g.extendedSystem == extendedSystem }

definition.value: The state of a BinaryRelation at a given time instant is the tuple of the values of its attributes.
A super system is a system whose components are, themselves, systems.
A metric is a measure used to assess mission success.

comment.en: SysML constraint NameNonEmpty: name != ""

definition.value: A mission plan is a collection of tasks, together with any required precedence relations among them, to be carried out in order to satisfy the mission within the given extended system and context.

comment.en: SysML constraint MissionContextMatchesPlanContext: mission.context == context

definition.value: Meaning is the informational content produced by exerting one or more modelets on input features, representing an interpretation of a phenomenon of the associated extended system within a given context.

comment.en: SysML constraint FeaturesMatchExtendedSystem: inputFeatures->ControlFunctions::forAll { in f : Feature; f.extendedSystem == extendedSystem }

definition.value: A cognitive function is a function that processes information by executing one or more modelets.

comment.en: SysML constraint SameTimeScale: initialTime.mRef == finalTime.mRef

definition.value: Stakeholder value is the amount of benefit at a cost provided to stakeholders within a given context.
Projection is a representation that maps a given situation of an extended system in a given context, into a representation in a chosen space, over a specified projection domain.

comment.en: SysML constraint PotentialBehaviorIsOfThisExtendedSystem: potentialBehavior.system == extendedSystem

definition.value: An agent is an entity capable of executing or commanding actions.

comment.en: SysML constraint HasAtLeastOneActionRole: SequenceFunctions::size(executes) > 0 or SequenceFunctions::size(commands) > 0

definition.value: A role is a context- and time-dependent designation, with associated responsibilities and constraints, that an entity may assume in order to contribute to the achievement or maintenance of a goal.
A modelet is a model fragment that represents a specific aspect of a referent system or entity.

An action specification is a concrete description, produced in response to an action trigger within a given context according to a chosen policy, that: (i) selects one or more actions from the candidate set determined by that policy, and (ii) assigns one or more responsible agents to each selected action.
The relationship between stakeholder and goal is "to desire".
Evaluation is an assessment of a projection with respect to a specific set of goals.

comment.en: SysML constraint PerformanceUseSameContext: performance->ControlFunctions::forAll { in p : PerformanceMeasure; p.context == context }

definition.value: The state of an entity at a given time instant is the tuple of the values of its attributes.
Binary relation between two entities.
A goal is a subset of the possible states of an extended system representing the conditions that an agent intends to achieve or maintain.

comment.en: SysML constraint DesiredStatesAreOfThisExtendedSystem: desiredStates->ControlFunctions::forAll { in st : SystemState; st.entity == extendedSystem }

definition.value: For a given stakeholder, the system of interest is the part of an extended system that constitutes the focus of engineering activities.
A model is an entity that represents another entity (its referent).
A capability is the ability of a system to perform a specific function successfully under stated conditions and acceptance criteria.
A sensor is an entity that acquires raw data about phenomena, properties, states, or attributes of another entity being observed in the extended system.

comment.en: SysML constraint SenseTargetsObservableEntities: senses->ControlFunctions::forAll { in s : Sense; observes->SequenceFunctions::includes(s.target) }

definition.value: A cognitive capability is a capability of a system that is realized by a cognitive function and enables the system to use knowledge to produce intentional action.

comment.en: SysML constraint SameSystem: behavior.system == capability.system
